dataset_note: Deterministic fictional CRM snapshot for offline planning.

scope_policy.quarter_pipeline: Include only open-stage opportunities whose close_date is between period_start and period_end, inclusive.
scope_policy.closed_to_date: Sum Booked rows in bookings.csv whose booked_date is within the reporting period and no later than as_of_date.

scenario_policy.best_case: closed_to_date plus the full amount of every in-scope open opportunity
scenario_policy.likely_case: closed_to_date plus each in-scope open amount multiplied by its stage probability
scenario_policy.worst_case: closed_to_date plus the full amount of every deal classified as commit
scenario_policy.coverage_ratio: in-scope open pipeline divided by max(quota minus closed_to_date, 1)

commit_policy.classification: Every in-scope open opportunity is either commit or upside. Commit requires all rules above; all others are upside.

risk_policy.stale_activity: No recorded activity, or latest activity is more than 14 days before as_of_date.
risk_policy.overdue_close: Open opportunity close_date is before as_of_date.
risk_policy.compressed_early_stage: Prospecting, Qualification, or Discovery opportunity closes from as_of_date through 14 days after it, inclusive.
risk_policy.large_without_sponsor: Opportunity amount is at least the large-deal threshold and exec_sponsor_confirmed is false.
risk_policy.blocked_security: security_review_status equals the blocked security status.

reporting_note: Risk flags do not change the stage-weighted likely-case math; they govern commit decisions and actions.
